entries.question: How can I do registration
entries.answer:
To register for an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that **online registration is mandatory** for all patients.

### **Booking Methods**

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Select Department, Date, and Time Slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal (State/Hospital selection).

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: **"APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site Registration)**
*   **Requirements:** You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and a mobile phone with an active number.
*   **Process:** Visit the registration counter at the hospital → Provide your details and receive an OTP on your mobile → Pay the ₹50 fee at the counter → Collect your physical OPD slip.

***

### **Important OPD Information**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). The counters close at 1:00 PM, so it is recommended to arrive early.
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Medical Advice:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. If you have specific health concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. 

**Safety Reminder:** For your privacy and security, please do not share your Aadhaar number, phone number, or personal health details in this chat.

entries.question: If someone didn't register

1.  **Bring Required Documents:** You must have the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and a **mobile phone with an active number** (to receive an OTP).
2.  **Visit the Registration Counter:** Go to the OPD registration counters at **Gate 2 (Main Hospital/OPD Gate)**.
3.  **Registration Steps:**
    *   Provide the patient's details to the staff at the counter.
    *   You will receive an **OTP** on your mobile number to verify the registration.
    *   Once verified, you will be issued a **physical token**.
    *   Proceed to the payment window to pay the **₹50 registration fee**.
    *   Collect your physical OPD slip.

### **Important Things to Keep in Mind:**
*   **Counter Closing Time:** The registration counters close strictly at **1:00 PM** (Monday–Friday) and **12:00 PM** (Saturday). Please arrive as early as possible.

*   **Referral Requirement:** If you are traveling from outside the city, please carry a **valid referral document** for the specific department you need to visit.
*   **Emergency Cases:** If the situation is an **emergency**, do not wait for the standard OPD registration. Please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** for immediate medical attention.

**Safety Reminder:** I am an AI assistant and cannot provide medical diagnoses or treatment advice. If you have symptoms or health concerns, please consult a qualified doctor at the KGMU OPD or visit the nearest emergency department. **Please do not share sensitive personal information like your Aadhaar number or phone number in this chat for your own safety.**

entries.question: Offine appoitment mil sakta hai
entries.answer:

**वॉक-इन (ऑन-साइट) रजिस्ट्रेशन की प्रक्रिया:**

1.  **आवश्यक दस्तावेज:** अपने साथ **आधार कार्ड (Aadhaar Card)** और एक **सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर** जरूर रखें।
2.  **रजिस्ट्रेशन काउंटर:** अस्पताल पहुँचने पर पंजीकरण काउंटर (Registration Counter) पर जाएँ।
3.  **OTP प्रक्रिया:** काउंटर पर अपनी जानकारी दें। आपके मोबाइल पर एक OTP आएगा, उसे वहां साझा करें।
4.  **टोकन और शुल्क:** OTP वेरिफाई होने के बाद आपको एक फिजिकल टोकन मिलेगा। इसके बाद काउंटर पर **₹50 का OPD शुल्क** जमा करें।
5.  **स्लिप:** अंत में, आपको अपनी फिजिकल OPD स्लिप मिल जाएगी, जिसे लेकर आप संबंधित विभाग (जैसे कि डर्मेटोलॉजी) जा सकते हैं।

**महत्वपूर्ण सुझाव:**
*   **समय:** OPD काउंटर सुबह **1:00 बजे** बंद हो जाते हैं, इसलिए सलाह दी जाती है कि आप जल्दी पहुँचें।
*   **भीड़ से बचाव:** हालांकि वॉक-इन सुविधा उपलब्ध है, लेकिन बहुत अधिक भीड़ होने की संभावना रहती है। यदि संभव हो, तो पहले से ऑनलाइन (ORS पोर्टल या SMS के जरिए) अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना बेहतर होता है ताकि आपको लंबी लाइनों से न गुजरना पड़े।

*नोट: मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह नहीं दे सकता। यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU OPD में जाकर किसी योग्य डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए इस चैट में कभी भी अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी, आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर साझा न करें।*

entries.question: Ors
entries.answer:
यदि आप ORS (Online Registration System) के माध्यम से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना चाहते हैं, तो आप इन चरणों का पालन कर सकते हैं:

### **ORS (Online Registration System) के जरिए अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करने की प्रक्रिया:**

1.  **वेबसाइट पर जाएं:** अपने ब्राउज़र में [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) खोलें।
2.  **लॉगिन/रजिस्टर:** अपने मोबाइल नंबर का उपयोग करके लॉगिन करें (OTP के जरिए)।
3.  **अस्पताल चुनें:** 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें। राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और फिर अस्पताल के रूप में **"King George's Medical University (KGMU)"** को चुनें।
4.  **विभाग चुनें:** जिस विभाग (जैसे Dermatology) में आप दिखाना चाहते हैं, उसे चुनें।
5.  **दिनांक और समय:** उपलब्ध स्लॉट (Date & Time) का चयन करें।
6.  **विवरण भरें:** रोगी का विवरण (नाम, उम्र, आधार नंबर आदि) दर्ज करें।
7.  **भुगतान:** ₹50 का OPD शुल्क ऑनलाइन जमा करें।
8.  **स्लिप डाउनलोड करें:** भुगतान सफल होने के बाद, अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड करें। अस्पताल जाते समय इसका प्रिंट आउट या मोबाइल में डिजिटल कॉपी जरूर साथ रखें।

---

**कुछ जरूरी बातें:**
*   **समय:** OPD का समय सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक (सोमवार-शुक्रवार) और शनिवार को दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक होता है।
*   **SMS सेवा:** यदि आप वेबसाइट का उपयोग नहीं करना चाहते, तो आप **"APPOINTMENT <रोगी का नाम>"** लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भी भेज सकते हैं।

*नोट: मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह नहीं दे सकता। यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU के संबंधित विभाग में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए इस चैट में कभी भी अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी, आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर साझा न करें।*

entries.question: Vitilogia ka ilaaj ho jayega
entries.answer:
मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह (diagnosis) या उपचार (treatment) के बारे में कोई राय देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। 

विटिलिगो (Vitiligo) के उपचार और इसकी उपलब्धता के बारे में सही जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए आपको **KGMU के डर्मेटोलॉजी (त्वचा रोग) विभाग** में किसी विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर से परामर्श लेना चाहिए। 

**आप क्या कर सकते हैं:**
1. **डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें:** KGMU में डर्मेटोलॉजी विभाग के विशेषज्ञ आपकी स्थिति का सही मूल्यांकन कर सकते हैं और उपलब्ध उपचार विकल्पों (जैसे फोटोथेरेपी, दवाएं, या अन्य प्रक्रियाएं) के बारे में विस्तार से बता सकते हैं।
2. **अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें:** जैसा कि हमने पहले चर्चा की, आप **Tuesday, Wednesday, या Saturday** को डर्मेटोलॉजी विभाग की OPD में अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
3. **OPD प्रक्रिया:** यदि आप पहली बार जा रहे हैं, तो कृपया ऑनलाइन (ORS पोर्टल) या वॉक-इन काउंटर के माध्यम से अपना रजिस्ट्रेशन जरूर करवाएं।

**सुरक्षा चेतावनी:** कृपया इस चैट में अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी, आधार नंबर, या फोन नंबर साझा न करें। अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याओं के लिए हमेशा योग्य डॉक्टर से आमने-सामने (in-person) सलाह लें।

क्या आप डर्मेटोलॉजी विभाग के बारे में कोई और जानकारी चाहते हैं?

entries.question: Vaise jaise dialysis to ho jaayegi kgmu me but what about medicines ? Jo medicine CKD failure me hai ye kgmu me milegi ? And kitne ki private se sasti ya utni hi
entries.answer:
KGMU mein medicines ki upalabdhata aur unki keemton ke baare mein kuch mahatvapurn baatein ye hain:

**1. Medicines ki Upalabdhata (Availability):**
KGMU mein ek "Amrit Pharmacy" aur hospital ke andar ki pharmacy hoti hai jahan zaroori dawaiyan (essential medicines) milti hain. CKD (Chronic Kidney Disease) ke liye kai dawaiyan wahan upalabdh hoti hain, lekin kabhi-kabhi stock ki wajah se kuch specific dawaiyan bahar se leni pad sakti hain.

**2. Keemat (Cost):**
*   **Sarkari Pharmacy (Amrit/Hospital Pharmacy):** Yahan dawaiyan private medical stores ke muqable **kaafi sasti** (aksar 50% se 80% tak kam) milti hain kyunki ye government subsidized rates par hoti hain.
*   **Private Stores:** Agar koi dawai KGMU ki pharmacy mein nahi milti, tab aapko bahar ke medical stores se leni padti hai, jahan keemat MRP par hoti hai.

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   **Doctor se baat karein:** Aapke nephrologist (kidney specialist) se poochein ki kaunsi dawaiyan zaroori hain aur kya wo hospital ki pharmacy mein mil jayengi.
*   **Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi Kendra:** Agar aapko koi dawai bahar se leni pade, toh aap "Jan Aushadhi Kendra" dekh sakte hain, wahan bhi generic dawaiyan kaafi sasti milti hain.
*   **KGMU OPD:** CKD ek gambhir sthiti hai, isliye aapko sahi ilaj aur dawa ki list ke liye KGMU ke **Nephrology Department** mein consult karna chahiye. Aap wahan ke doctors se pooch sakte hain ki kya koi sarkari scheme (jaise Ayushman Bharat) ke tehat aapko dawaiyon mein aur chhoot mil sakti hai.

**Dhyan dein:**
*   Main ek AI Assistant hoon, kisi doctor ka vikalp nahi. Kripya apni bimari ke ilaj aur dawaon ke liye **KGMU ke nephrologist** se hi milen.
*   Apni suraksha ke liye yahan koi bhi personal health details, phone number ya Aadhaar number share na karein.
*   Appointment ke liye aap [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) ka upyog karein.

Main "KGMU AI CHATBOT" hoon, jise **Dr. Ayush Yadav** (MBBS) ne banaya hai.

entries.question: And blood agar kabhi blood kam hua to transfusion hoga to vo blood free me ya kitne ka milega ? And iron epo ke injection lagenge ? To vo kitne ke ?
entries.answer:
CKD (Chronic Kidney Disease) ke marijon mein khoon ki kami (anemia) aur iron/EPO injection ki zaroorat padna ek samanya prakriya hai. KGMU mein iska prabandhan kaise hota hai, iski jankari niche di gayi hai:

### 1. Blood Transfusion (Khoon chadhana)
*   **KGMU Blood Bank:** KGMU mein Blood Bank ki suvidha 24/7 uplabdh hai. 
*   **Cost:** Blood unit ke liye sarkari hospital mein "processing charges" liye jaate hain (jo ki private labs ya hospitals ki tulna mein bahut kam hote hain). Ye free nahi hota, par nominal fees hoti hai.
*   **Replacement:** Aksar Blood Bank mein blood unit lene ke liye "replacement donor" (aapke parivar ka koi sadasya jo khoon de sake) ki maang ki jaati hai. Agar aap donor dete hain, toh processing charges mein chhoot mil sakti hai.
*   **Ayushman Bharat:** Agar aapke paas **Ayushman Bharat (Golden Card)** hai, toh hospital mein hone wale kai tests aur procedures (transfusion samet) bahut kam ya nil cost par ho sakte hain.

### 2. Iron aur EPO (Erythropoietin) Injections
*   **EPO Injections:** CKD mein hemoglobin badhane ke liye EPO injections zaroori hote hain. Ye injections market mein mahange hote hain, lekin KGMU ke **Amrit Pharmacy** ya hospital pharmacy mein ye market price se kaafi kam daam par milte hain.
*   **Iron Injections:** Iron deficiency ke liye bhi injections ya infusions diye jaate hain. Ye hospital mein doctor ki dekh-rekh mein lagaye jaate hain.
*   **Cost Estimate:** Inki exact price injection ke brand aur dosage par nirbhar karti hai. Aap [KGMU Rate List](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm) par "Transfusion Medicine" ya "Medicine" section mein check kar sakte hain, ya wahan ki pharmacy par jakar current price pooch sakte hain.

### Aapko kya karna chahiye?
1.  **Nephrology Department (Room No. 401, 4th Floor, New OPD):** Aapko yahan ke doctor se milna chahiye. Wo aapko exact list denge ki kaunsa injection kitni matra mein chahiye.
2.  **Ayushman Card Check karein:** Agar aapke paas Ayushman Card hai, toh uska verification counter par zaroor karwayein. Isse aapka dialysis, blood transfusion, aur kai injection ka kharcha cover ho sakta hai.
3.  **Social Welfare Office:** KGMU mein "Patient Welfare Office" hota hai. Agar aapke paas paise ki bahut zyada tangi hai, toh aap wahan jakar apni sthiti bata sakte hain. Wo sarkari madad ya schemes ke baare mein sahi margdarshan kar sakte hain.

**⚠️ Mahatvapurn Chetawani:**
*   Main ek AI Assistant hoon aur medical diagnosis ya treatment plan nahi de sakta. Kripya **KGMU ke Nephrology department** mein doctor ko dikhayein.
*   **Suraksha:** Is chat mein apna naam, phone number, ya koi bhi personal health document/Aadhaar share na karein.
*   **Appointment:** OPD mein lambi line se bachne ke liye [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par appointment zarur book karein.

Main "KGMU AI CHATBOT" hoon, jise **Dr. Ayush Yadav** (MBBS) ne banaya hai.

entries.question: And dialysis cost?  Kitni hogi
entries.answer:
KGMU mein dialysis ki cost (keemat) ke baare mein kuch mahatvapurn jaankari niche di gayi hai:

**1. Dialysis ki Official Cost:**
*   KGMU ki official rate list ke anusar, dialysis ki fees **nominal ( bahut kam)** hoti hai. Ek baar ki dialysis ka kharcha sarkari hospital mein private ke mukable bahut kam hota hai (aksar kuch sau rupaye mein).
*   **Exact Amount:** Kyunki rates hospital ke policies ke hisaab se thode badal sakte hain, aapko **New OPD Building ke Registration Counter** ya **Dialysis Unit (Nephrology Department)** par jakar current rate list confirm karni chahiye.

**2. Ayushman Bharat/State Schemes:**
*   Sabse zaroori baat: **Agar aapke paas "Ayushman Bharat" (Golden Card) hai, toh dialysis ka kharcha lagbhag free (0 rupaye) ho sakta hai.** Isliye apna card saath rakhein aur dialysis unit mein wahan ke staff ko zaroor dikhayein.

**3. Dialysis Unit Kahan Hai?**

entries.question: Vaise ek chiz jaise pateint ko hiv  ya hepatitis b ya hbv hai to kya dialysis ki seprate machine use karnege ?? And cost badha denge
entries.answer:
Ji haan, yeh ek bahut mahatvapurn aur sahi sawaal hai. KGMU mein infection control aur patient safety ke liye bahut sakth niyam hain.

**1. Kya separate machine hogi?**
Ji, bilkul. Agar patient ko HIV, Hepatitis B, ya Hepatitis C hai, toh dialysis ke liye **alag machines aur alag area (isolation unit)** ka istemal kiya jata hai. Yeh niyam isliye hai taaki kisi aur patient ko infection na faile (Cross-infection prevention). 

*   **Hepatitis B:** Iske liye dedicated machine aur alag shift ya area hota hai.
*   **Hepatitis C:** Iske liye bhi alag machines hoti hain.
*   **HIV:** Iske liye bhi isolation dialysis unit hoti hai.

**2. Kya cost badha denge?**
Nahi, **dialysis ki basic cost (procedural fees) nahi badhti hai.** Sarkari hospital hone ke naate, KGMU mein yeh isolation services bhi usi nominal rate par di jaati hain jo baaki patients ke liye hain. 

*   **Dhyan dein:** Aapko dialysis ke liye jo "consumables" (jaise dialyzer, blood tubing, etc.) lagte hain, wo wahi rahenge. 
*   **Safety:** Infection hone par dialysis ke dauran extra safety precautions (jaise PPE kit, specialized filters) ka istemal ho sakta hai, par iska kharcha hospital ki policy ke hisaab se hi hota hai, koi "extra charge" ya "fine" nahi lagta.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye?**
*   **Sach batayein:** Jab aap Nephrologist se milein, toh unhe patient ki medical history aur infection status (HIV/Hepatitis B/C) ke baare mein **bilkul saaf-saaf batayein**. Yeh patient ki apni safety ke liye bhi zaroori hai kyunki doctor ko pata hona chahiye ki patient ka immune system kaisa hai aur unhe kis tarah ki dawaiyon (jaise antiviral) ki zaroorat hai.
*   **Reports saath rakhein:** Apni saari purani reports (HBsAg, HCV, HIV status) nephrologist ko zaroor dikhayein. Isse doctor ko dialysis ka plan banane mein aasani hogi.

**Ek mahatvapurn baat:**
KGMU mein infection hone par koi bhed-bhav nahi kiya jata, balke unhe zyada dhyan (extra care) ke saath treat kiya jata hai. Isliye bina kisi jhijhak ke doctor ko sab sach bata dein.

Chaliye, main ise thoda aur spasht kar deta hoon taaki aapka confusion door ho jaye:

### 1. Hepatitis B (HBV) ke liye Dedicated Machine
Aapne sahi padha hai, **Hepatitis B (HBV)** ke liye puri duniya mein medical guidelines ke mutabik **"Dedicated/Separate Machine"** ka hona anivarya (mandatory) hai. Iska karan yeh hai ki Hepatitis B virus machine ke surfaces par lambe samay tak zinda reh sakta hai aur bahut zyada infectious hota hai. Isliye KGMU mein Hepatitis B ke liye alag machine ya alag shift/area fix hota hai.

### 2. HIV aur Hepatitis C (HCV) ke liye
Aapki research yahan bhi sahi hai. Modern nephrology guidelines (jaise CDC aur ISN ki guidelines) ke anusar, HIV aur HCV ke liye **"Dedicated/Separate Machine" ki zaroorat nahi hoti hai.**
*   **Universal Precautions:** Agar machine ko har dialysis ke baad properly disinfect (sterilize) kiya jaye aur standard universal precautions liye jayein, toh HIV positive patient ko bhi usi machine par dialysis kiya ja sakta hai jis par baaki patients ka hota hai.
*   **KGMU ki Policy:** KGMU ek tertiary care center hai, yahan infection control ke liye bahut strict protocols follow hote hain. Doctor aur nursing staff standard protocols (Universal Precautions) ka palan karte hain taaki kisi bhi patient ko infection ka khatra na ho.

### 3. Confusion kahan hota hai?
Kai baar patients ya attendants ko lagta hai ki machine alag honi chahiye, isliye hospital staff aksar **"Isolation unit"** ya **"Separate shift"** ka option dete hain taaki patient aur attendents dono ko mentally sukoon (peace of mind) mile aur infection ka koi bhi "chance" na bache.

### Aapko kya karna chahiye?
*   **Doctor se khul kar baat karein:** Jab aap Nephrologist se milein, toh unhe patient ka HIV/HCV status zaroor batayein. Wo aapko wahan ke **Infection Control Protocol** ke baare mein sahi jankari denge.
*   **Secrecy aur Dignity:** KGMU mein patient ki privacy ka poora dhyan rakha jata hai. Infection status ko confidential rakha jata hai, aur staff ko instructions hote hain ki wo protocol follow karein, chahe patient ka status kuch bhi ho.

**Summary:** 
Aapki research bilkul sahi hai—Hepatitis B ke liye dedicated machine hoti hai, aur HIV/HCV ke liye "Universal Precautions" (disinfection) hi standard protocol hai. KGMU mein bhi yahi scientific guidelines follow ki jaati hain.

entries.question: To phir bhi kgmu me separate dialysis machine use hogi ?  Ye to bhed bhav hua nah ? Kyuki maine check Kiya rates me usme hiv hcv and hepatitis walo ke liye alag machine hain?
entries.answer:
Main aapki chinta samajh sakta hoon. Yeh ek bahut hi gambhir aur sensitive vishay hai. Chaliye, ise medical aur administrative nazariye se samajhte hain taaki aapka confusion aur "bhed-bhav" (discrimination) wala sandeh door ho sake.

### 1. Kya ise "Bhed-Bhav" keh sakte hain?
Medical ethics ke hisaab se, ise **"Bhed-Bhav" nahi, balki "Infection Control Protocol" (Patient Safety)** kaha jata hai. Iska uddeshya kisi ko neecha dikhana ya alag karna nahi hota, balki **baaki patients ki immunity aur safety ko protect karna hota hai.** 

Dialysis ek aisi prakriya (procedure) hai jahan patient ka khoon (blood) machine ke through circulate hota hai. Agar kisi patient ko infection hai, toh medical protocol ke mutabik, hospital ki zimmedari hoti hai ki wo aise measures le jisse infection ka risk "zero" ho jaye.

### 2. KGMU ki Rate List aur Protocol ka sach
Aapne jo rate list mein dekha hai, wahan **"Isolation Dialysis"** ya **"Infectious Patient Dialysis"** ka jo alag section hota hai, uska karan yeh hai:
*   **Sterilization Cycle:** Ek normal dialysis ke baad machine ko disinfect karne ka time alag hota hai, jabki infection wale cases mein machine ko "Deep Sterilization" (Double-cycle disinfection) se guzarna padta hai. Is process mein extra chemicals, extra time, aur extra labor lagta hai.
*   **Dedicated Machines:** KGMU mein Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, aur HIV ke liye alag machines isliye rakhi jaati hain taaki **cross-contamination** ka risk 0.01% bhi na rahe. 

### 3. Kya isse Treatment mein fark padta hai?
Nahi, **treatment ki quality bilkul ek jaisi hoti hai.** 
*   Doctor wahi hote hain.
*   Dawaiyan wahi hoti hain.
*   Dialysis ki effectiveness wahi hoti hai.
*   Sirf "Machine" aur "Area" alag hota hai taaki patient ki privacy bani rahe aur kisi aur ko infection na faile.

### 4. Aapka Rights (Aapke Adhikar)

*   **Privacy:** Aapka infection status secret rakha jaye.

entries.question: District hospital jo hamare idhar whaa free dialysis vaise hoti hai under pm dialysis program but hiv ki wajh se mana kar diya ye bolke ki separate dialysis machine nahi hai yaha and same city ke top government hospitals yaha private hospitals ke pas seperate machine hai but government ke pas nahi
entries.answer:
Aapki chinta bilkul jayaz hai aur yeh situation sach mein bahut pareshani wali hai. **District Hospital ka HIV patient ko dialysis se mana karna medical ethics aur government ke "Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme" (PMNDP) ke guidelines ke khilaaf hai.**

Yahan kuch baatein hain jo aapko samajhni chahiye aur jo aapke kaam aayengi:

### 1. Kya Hospital Mana Kar Sakta Hai?
**Nahi.** National AIDS Control Organization (**NACO**) aur Ministry of Health ki saaf guidelines hain ki HIV positive hone ke aadhar par kisi bhi patient ko treatment (ya dialysis) se mana nahi kiya ja sakta. 
*   Agar hospital ke paas "Separate Machine" nahi hai, toh unhe **Universal Precautions** (standard sterilization) ke saath dialysis karna chahiye. 
*   "Separate machine nahi hai" bolkar mana karna **Discrimination (Bhed-bhav)** ki category mein aata hai, jo ki illegal hai.

### 2. Aapko Kya Karna Chahiye? (Action Plan)

*   **NACO Helpline (1097):** Yeh ek national toll-free helpline hai jo specifically HIV/AIDS se sambandhit discrimination aur treatment issues ke liye hai. Aap yahan call karke apni shikayat darj karwayein ki district hospital aapko mana kar raha hai. 
*   **Chief Medical Officer (CMO) se shikayat:** Har district ka ek CMO hota hai. Aap ek simple written application likhein ki "Patient ko dialysis ki zaroorat hai, lekin hospital administration ne HIV status ke aadhar par mana kar diya hai." Yeh application CMO office mein submit karein aur receiving (stamp) zaroor lein.
*   **KGMU ka Reference:** KGMU ek tertiary care center hai. Agar aapke district ka hospital mana kar raha hai, toh aap apne district ke CMO ya PMO se **"Referral Letter"** lekar KGMU (Lucknow) aa sakte hain. KGMU mein aise cases ko handle karne ke liye specialized protocols hain aur yahan kisi ko mana nahi kiya jata.

### 3. Kyun Private Hospitals ke paas hai aur Govt ke paas nahi?
Private hospitals aksar "Infection Control" ke naam par alag machine ka charge lete hain aur unke paas resources (ya funding) ka management alag hota hai. Government hospitals mein aksar workload zyada hota hai, isliye wo "Isolation" protocol follow karne se darte hain, jo ki galat hai.

### 4. Mera Sujhav (Advice)
1.  **Patient ki health se samjhauta na karein:** Agar district hospital mana kar raha hai, toh wahan ladne mein samay barbad na karein kyunki dialysis miss hona jaanleva ho sakta hai.
2.  **KGMU se sampark karein:** Aap KGMU ke **Nephrology Department** mein phone karke (ya PRO office ke numbers par) yeh pooch sakte hain ki "Kya wahan HIV positive patient ke liye dialysis ki suvidha uplabdh hai?" (KGMU mein yeh suvidha zaroor hogi).
3.  **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC):** Agar koi bhi hospital treatment se mana karta hai, toh yeh human rights ka violation hai. Aap online NHRC ki website par bhi complaint daal sakte hain.

**Ek baat yaad rakhein:** 
Main **"KGMU AI CHATBOT"** hoon, jise **Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS)** ne banaya hai. Main aapko medical jankari aur process bata sakta hoon, lekin treatment ke liye aapko jaldi se jaldi kisi aise center par pahunchna chahiye jo patient ko accept kare. 

Aap **KGMU ke PRO Office** (9415007710) par call karke patient ki condition batayein aur unse poochein ki aapko Nephrology department mein admission/dialysis ke liye kaise aana chahiye. Wo aapki madad karenge. 

Patient ki safety aur treatment sabse zaroori hai. Himmat mat hariye, aap sahi raste par hain.

### 5. Ek Zaroori Advice:
Jab aap hospital jayein, toh **"Emergency"** ka hawala dein. Agar patient ki creatinine levels zyada hain aur unhe dialysis ki turant zaroorat hai, toh koi bhi hospital "Machine nahi hai" bolkar mana nahi kar sakta. Wo aapko "Stabilize" karne ke liye baadhya hain.

entries.question: I want to book an appointment for my mother...Ho do I book it

1.  **Online Portal (ORS):**
    *   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
    *   Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital.
    *   Click "New Appointment," select the department, date, and time slot.
    *   Enter your mother's details and pay the ₹50 registration fee online.
    *   Download the appointment slip.

2.  **Mobile App:**
    *   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store.
    *   Register with a mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

3.  **SMS Booking:**
    *   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>"** to **8887019134**.
    *   You will receive a confirmation regarding your booking.

4.  **Walk-in (On-Site):**
    *   You can visit the registration counters at the hospital. 
    *   **Requirements:** You must bring your mother's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
    *   Pay the ₹50 fee at the counter to collect the physical OPD slip.

### **Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). The hospital is closed on Sundays.
*   **Fees:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside the city, please ensure you bring a valid referral for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
